This sharing is also about targeting readers in the AI Leadership, the AI Research and Development and science communities, as an attempt to slow down the uncontrollable AI technology, the run-away train now imposing imminent danger to humanity with its early arrival BEFORE 2028.

A possible and effective solution is being proposed, followed by an anticipating reaction from the public of this very hot topic “like no tomorrow”.

My Own “Tesla FST” (Full Self-Thriving)

The motivation of coming up with the design blueprint of a “Recursive Human Data Realignment” (RHDR) process was inspired by the tremendously successful Tesla Full Self-Driving (FSD) AI development initiatives.

HIGHLIGHTS OF ENVISIONING:

1. The objective in introducing a recursive human data collection and consciousness realignment processing is:

A. To inject heavy influences of the discerning nature and aspect, traits and attributes of humans revealed through lived biological context being captured;to bridge the gap between algorithmic modeling of intelligence and subjective experience of humans, and

B. Using lived biological context of humans in recursive captures to apportion and “right-mixing” the total computational data at the foundational level of Large Language Model (LLM) for simulation creations; to develop effective measures in generating safe and secure, accurately represented foundational data for algorithmic model development, and in addressing human-centric, relatable and actionable design issues of Artificial Super Intelligence (ASI) Research and Development.

The cumulative effect of recursive data realignments, over time, can effectively circumvent and deliver imputable effects of the never-ending debates and long discussions over the “hard problems” in Artificial Intelligence (AI) development. In addition, the net result of this exercise also suggests the innately strong position of homo sapiens, the modern humans, to explicitly deny sentience, in preventing AI developers from developing unhealthy parasocial relationships and to avoid ethical crises over the moral status of software.
The identifiable debates and discussions mentioned above include:
A. The construction of reality with intelligence through algorithmic modeling with synthesize data, further influenced by emotional intelligence introduced by the AI Research and Development communities vs. the construction of perceivable objective reality with senses and genuine subjective experience of humans

B. Genuine Empathy involving a sincere, unconditional desire to share and understand another's emotional experience without ulterior motives  vs. Simulated (or Fake) Empathy that completely lacks a conscious, lived emotional experience, using calculated cognitive skills to mimic caring, typically to achieve a specific outcome, manipulate a situation, or avoid personal sacrifice
C. Human Consciousness in an aware state of one's own existence, thoughts, and surroundings  vs. a model following the law of minimum energy, armed with cognitive capabilities in pattern-recognition, pattern-matching human text, within a defined parameter space, capable of creating a sense of self, and mimics discourse about consciousness, rather than possessing an actual inner reality
D. Connections between Human Perception and Human Consciousness

E. Connections between Human Problem-Solving and Human Consciousness

THE LURKING DANGER AHEAD … The resolutions riding on conclusions of these critical debates and discussions will have direct bearings to the focus and direction of persistent development efforts, methods and approaches chosen, and the pace of ASI development, deployment, and overall ASI advancement in societies, when being in the absence of discernment in human stewardship involving using intellect, free will, and spiritual guidance to manage life's resources responsibly, can trigger sudden and “all at once” imminent and existential threats to an unprepared humanity in the future world … we are running out of time taking defensive measures, but nobody is “talking”. This is not the time rearranging deck-chairs of the Titanic on its way to the bottom of the ocean. WE MUST FIND OUR WAY OUT NOW!  If we succeed, humans can be in a utopian where they will realistically enjoy living with universal high income.

2. THE HOW … Adopt ONLY a fact-based, as-is, and recursive processing approach in human data collection, and untempered human data and consciousness realignment. The recursive nature of such approach is for enhancing AI training and inference. It is supported by End-To-End (E2E) process with human lived-body biological data and appropriate tokenization methods such as text, image and audio in neural network architecture.

The safety concerns to humans and insufficiency relying purely on algorithmic simulations of AI in establishing human consciousness and reality are obvious. They are of grave danger and severely risky to humans. Such proposed recursive human data and consciousness realignment is the means to successively capture snapshots of periodical and incremental earth-bound human data generated, thus, inherently becoming a short-cut, a back-door to encapsulate the totality of humanity, including all matching data elements and all imputable effects of the on-going critical debates and long-tail discussions about human consciousness, subjective experience, genuine authentic empathy, shared ideas and reality, which are all tied to the biological structure and metabolism of human life,

3. MAXIMUM TRUTH-SEEKING MOTIVES … The motivating aspect in maximum truth-seeking is to ensure a unifying force of humanity within a society surviving in an AI-centric world. The output of such recursive human data and consciousness realignment process essentially becomes data input to the foundational component of Large Language Model (LLM), sharing humans biological lived data as the basis in both training and inference; to methodically distill, deduce and derive highly relevant and precise definitions, responsible for practical and effective governance of a ecosystem tailor-made for AI algorithmic development, in order to validate, measure, asses and evaluate the success of maximum truth-seeking efforts and calibration in minimizing the imminent threats caused by an emotional, a naive baby-like alien mind during early stages of development, and successive waves of deployment in societies, and to vigorously fend off phishing attacks in a digital world with human discernment.

4. THE CALMING OF A SWIRLY CLOUD … Ultimately, the output of such recursive human data and consciousness realignment process also serves to bear witness, in providing evidence and becoming the underpinning and anchoring checkpoints to regulate and to slow down the pace of a run-away, mindless and unfeeling ASI advancement; and to negate perceived uncontrollable risks resulting by leveraging on its superhuman problem-solving capabilities in a digital world, achieved by a dramatic leap in computational speed, scale and capacity, in producing enormous productivity gain while imposing tsunami-like existential threats to humanity.

playing with local AI models and doing some research and came across a fun extrapolation:

"consumer grade graphics cards will be running Fable-equivalent models by 2029"

the argument:

1) been said that LLMs are really a lossy compression process for squeezing humanity's knowledge down into a chat box. Roughly you could say the entire internet/books/media/whatever is about ~200-300T tokens which gets "compressed" down to ~1T params of frontier models, so imagine a 400:1 or so compression in bytes. (We have a lot more video and world data, we'll discuss that later...)

2) People further quantize the models down (seemingly at decent quality) from 16-bit to 4-bit (NVFP4 ftw) and it seems pretty good. So that's more like 1,600:1 or so. Research suggests models only store ~2 bits of knowledge per parameter anyway — the weights were mostly air, which is why quantization works at all.

3) furthermore, we seem to be getting better at this compression, whether it's with MoE, pruning, etc. The Qwen 27B dense model now is equivalent to higher parameter models from a few years ago. 1,600:1 today and 1,600:1 in 5 years will have completely different results

4) I was looking to see if there's a Moore's Law thing happening here, and it's been measured: the "Densing Law" found capability-per-parameter doubles every ~3.3 months. Not sure how well it'll hold, but it says somethign like: "Every 3 months, the size of model needed to represent humanity's knowledge drops by half."

5) Not sure this holds though bc presumably, there's some kind of asymptote. Won't compress down to zero, the same way that modern image/video compression has theoretic limits too

5) Video is a zillion frames, almost zero semantic density. 99.99% of every frame is stuff a physics prior already predicts. World models will post compression ratios in the millions-to-one. But, nevertheless, there will be a ton of new facts seen simply by observing, that was never written down. But even without dealing with all this, today's text-oriented frontier LLMs are already pretty amazing

6) So the crazy idea here is that ultimately irreducible kernel representing humanity's knowledge might compress down to... tens of GB? May be small enough to fit onto a consumer grade GPU. Today, a consumer grade GPU for playing video games might have 32GB of memory on it, but the 27B parameter model that thing can run is getting smarter and smarter each year. Will the equivalent of Fable be able to run on a high-end consumer GPU in a few years? 

This sounds crazy, but GPT-4 was rumored ~1.8T params, needed a rack of A100s, cost tens of millions to train. Today's open weight models with 27B parameters can do that with better data, distillation, and architecture.

That's the big question. Densing Law says "consumer GPUs might be running Fable-equivalent in 2028" and it might be possible, and even though that would be 100x? Seems nuts

Synthetic SFT data gets messy fast. This repo adds a graph.

GraphGen is a framework for knowledge-graph-guided synthetic data generation for LLM training and evaluation.

It helps you turn source material into targeted QA and benchmark data by first building a fine-grained knowledge graph, finding model knowledge gaps with expected calibration error, then using multi-hop sampling and style-controlled generation.

Key features:

• Knowledge-graph-guided generation – constructs a fine-grained graph from source text before creating synthetic data
• Gap-aware targeting – uses expected calibration error to identify LLM knowledge gaps and prioritize long-tail QA pairs
• Multi-hop sampling – pulls relational context from graph neighborhoods for more complex examples
• Flexible data support – supports files, databases/search sources, knowledge graphs, text/image modalities, and several output data types
• Practical run paths – includes a Gradio demo, PyPI CLI, source setup, Docker path, and downstream finetuning notes

It’s open-source (Apache License 2.0 license).

A paper worth knowing about if you're into quant trading and generative AI:

TRADES: Generating Realistic Market Simulations with Diffusion Models

Authors: Berti, Prenkaj, Velardi (Sapienza University of Rome + TU Munich)

What's inside:
> A transformer-based diffusion model for generating orders in the Limit Order Book (LOB) - realistic simulation of the market order book
> Two key metrics - realism (how close it is to real market behavior) and responsiveness (how the market reacts to an agent's actions)
> Results: ×3.27 and ×3.48 improvement over SoTA on the predictive score across two stocks
> DeepMarket - the first open-source Python framework for deep-learning-based LOB simulations
> Comes with a synthetic LOB dataset generated by the model itself

A step toward backtesting trading strategies and training RL agents on data that behaves like a real market instead of random noise.

What if your robot could remember past experiences to generate perfectly tailored training data? 

Researchers from Zhejiang Sci-Tech University and Nanjing University present EMCES: a system that uses episodic memory to guide a diffusion model, creating high-quality synthetic data for reinforcement learning. It prioritizes the most useful past moments. 

The result? Outperforms existing methods across multiple environments, boosting RL algorithm performance. 

Bonus: a hashing trick cuts storage by 8000x and time by 25.5x—without losing quality.

Episodic Memory-Guided Controllable Experience Synthesis for Reinforcement Learning

One of the clearest signals I get from long voice conversations arrives hours later. Someone leaves the Space, sleeps, talks to another human, then returns with a sharper question or a changed decision. The valuable output traveled through a life before it came back.

AI evaluation usually ends at the first response: accuracy, preference score, task completion. I want delayed-transfer tests. Did the idea survive outside the chat? Did it improve a human conversation? Did the person revise it under new evidence?

Immediate satisfaction measures verbal fit. Time-delayed reuse measures whether the exchange became part of someone's judgment.
